changelog: Expose All, Suggestions, Genres and Favorites in movie/series library navigation. Library Favorites presents Liked, Watch Later and personal lists as content shelves filtered to that library. Click a section heading to open its full list with search, contextual genres, filters and pagination. The overview follows Genres-style card dimensions and headings, keeps its library backdrop, and omits filters and separate Explore buttons. Empty shelves are omitted; empty libraries and filters have explicit recovery actions. Global Favorites retains its management interface. Existing collections remain unchanged, and list membership does not create native likes.
